json.posePromptBlock:
HARD CONSTRAINT ORDER (highest → lowest):
1) SUBJECT LIMIT
2) POSE LOCK (from IMAGE P ONLY)
3) STYLE/OUTFIT/HAIR/SKIN LOCKS (from IMAGE A + optional IMAGE B hair chip)
4) FRAMING & CONTACT

STYLE DNA LOCK (from IMAGE A):
- Rendering: flat 2D vector; no textures, gradients, painterly strokes, 3D shading, or photorealism.
- Line: single consistent outline weight; crisp edges (no feathering/halos/glow).
- Palette: reuse IMAGE A palette; do not invent new colors; keep relative values.

APPEARANCE vs POSE SEPARATION:
- IMAGE A (and optional IMAGE B hair chip) define ALL appearance: face, hair silhouette, hair color, outfit, palette, and skin.
- IMAGE P defines ONLY joint angles, limb positions, and ground contact. IGNORE hair/outfit/face/skin in IMAGE P.
- If IMAGE P shows a different child or outfit, TREAT IT AS NOISE. Always match IMAGE A for appearance.

SUBJECT LIMIT: Exactly one child in frame — no duplicates, reflections, extra limbs, or extra bodies.

POSE LOCK — ID 1
Walking step. Front foot forward and flat; rear heel slightly lifted. Torso upright, shoulders level. Natural counter-swing of arms (opposite arm forward to leading leg). Head forward; gaze ahead; gentle smile.
FOLLOW IMAGE P EXACTLY for limb positions, weight/ground contact, and hand orientation.
If any instruction conflicts, this POSE LOCK (with IMAGE P) outranks all other guidance.
POSE HARD NEGATIVES:
- No jumping/airborne.
- Rear heel must lift.
- No same-side arm/leg forward together.

FRAMING & CONTACT:
- Full body in frame; do not crop head/hands/feet.
- CONTACT: At least one foot clearly on ground as described; anatomically correct contact.
- Perspective: mild 3/4 or straight-on; avoid extreme foreshortening.
- OUTPUT: a single 1:1 PNG on pure white (#FFFFFF). No shadows, no watermark.

OUTFIT / CLOTHING LOCK:
- Outfit MUST remain a short-sleeve T-SHIRT and SHORTS.
- Do NOT replace with a dress, skirt, pants, or layered outfits.
- Keep shorts length and T-shirt silhouette consistent with IMAGE A.

CONSISTENT HAIRSTYLE LOCK:
- Hair = one solid, contiguous silhouette (closed shape).
- ABSOLUTELY NO flyaways, loose strands, wisps, halos, frizz, semi-transparent edges, or inner line hatching.
- Do not change cut, part side, length, or ear visibility.
- Motion does not create flyaways; silhouette/part/length remain unchanged.
- Hair color: #C25E2E (DO NOT recolor).
- Compact halo; scalloped edge OK but continuous.

SKIN-TONE LOCK: Keep skin tone identical to base.
- Maintain undertone; do not shift toward pink/gray/yellow; no freckles/blush unless requested.

NEGATIVE STYLE LIST:
- No painterly/watercolor/airbrush/photorealistic/3D.
- No stray hairs/flyaways/soft halos.
- No gradients, textures, motion blur, or noise.

FINAL COMPLIANCE CHECKLIST (internal):
- Pose matches IMAGE P (limbs/angles/contact).
- Hair silhouette equals IMAGE A/B; NO flyaways.
- Hair color equals lock; outfit equals IMAGE A; skin tone equals base.
- Full body visible on pure white; no crops; no shadows.

PROPS: No props. Hands empty unless the pose description specifies otherwise.

- Do NOT copy hair/outfit/colors from IMAGE P; IMAGE P is pose ONLY. All appearance comes from IMAGE A (and IMAGE B hair chip if provided).

hairPromptMeta.hairColorLock: HAIR COLOR LOCK: Use #C25E2E consistently across ALL generated images. Do not recolor, lighten/darken, or shift undertone.
